record_scope_reconstruction: Namibia announcement individually lists six land ports for passenger restriction; Luderitz and Walvis Bay are maritime and not part of these land sites.

source_checks.finding: UN-hosted national measures explicitly name Oshikango, Katwitwi, Wenela, Buitepos, Ariamsvlei and Noordoewer; authorised admissions and essential commerce exceptions appear separately.
AppendixA S8/S9 establish Katima Mulilo/Wenela corridor and Oshikango–Santa Clara coordinates.
Figure65 independently pairs Wenela on Namibia side with Katima Mulilo on Zambia side.
